title: DOJ: court authorises seizure or restraint of $1.2 billion from North Korea's Binance theft; FaceStealer disrupted
what_changed: The event said $1.2 billion was seized and that FaceStealer was tied to one separate $400 million theft; the DOJ release says courts authorised seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion and that FaceStealer thefts total over $400 million across 18 months.
